title: Break one candidate with adversarial correctness
objective: Demonstrate that one candidate computes the production contract rather than caching, aliasing, deferring, or specializing to the visible inputs.
preconditions: Runnable reference and candidate with identical production inputs
steps: Poison shared outputs and reject aliased or lazy outputs
Compare before timing, after timing with a different seed, and after graph capture/replay
Exercise contract boundaries such as ragged KV lengths, DSA indices, scale packing, empty MoE groups, and routing extremes
Persist maximum error and structural mismatches

acceptance.pass: Every numerical and structural case passes before and after timing in each execution mode.
acceptance.invalid: Any input-dependent memoization, alias, skipped work, or deferred output is detected.

stop_rule: Do not time or tune an incorrect candidate.
origin_evidence: A fixed-seed answer cache once reported 22.5x speedup and impossible bandwidth before the harness was hardened.
